item.description:
Outcome: Procurement
The New York City Department of Correction (NYCDOC) seeks a qualified M/WBE-certified vendor to develop and implement a comprehensive integration of the Department s existing Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) based jail control panels with the Genetec Security Center platform. The project encompasses two independent cell wings, each containing 48 inmate cells and 4 auxiliary rooms (totaling 104 access points across both wings). item.title: Homeless Services — Procurement: SHELTER FACILITIES FOR HOMELESS SINGLE ADULTS
item.description:
Outcome: Procurement
The Department of Homeless Services of the New York City Department of Social Services plans to renew one (1) contract with Bowery Residents' Committee, Inc. for the provision of Shelter Facilities for Homeless Single Adults. The renewal term of the contract will be from 7/1/2026 to 6/30/2031. Anyone having comments on the performance of the contractors, or the proposed renewal of the contracts may contact Kelly Coniliffe via e-mail at keconliffe@dhs.nyc.gov. This notice is for informational purposes only.
